title: Planning stops the whole job when the critic says the reading misread the request; six jobs lost this way

brief.question: When the plan reviewer says the request was misread, should Athena re-read it once instead of failing?
brief.if_yes: The reader gets the reviewer's finding and tries once more; planning then resumes with the new reading.
brief.if_no: Jobs keep failing at planning on a misread, and the request needs a manual retry.
brief.cost: One extra reading call per misread (estimate: under $0.20), plus a design and code change.
brief.recommendation: Yes: six jobs failed this way, and in one the reviewer's own findings said the reading matched.
